classification_definitions.unresolved: Missing/ambiguous source or source-visible contradiction prevents affected assertion credit.

qualification_limits: Successor uses upstream NATS single-node loopback TCP and FileStorage. No natscell.Start, in-process transport, TLS/auth, R3/failover or production deployment credit.
Response fixtures skip without root:root and use /dev/shm tmpfs; no capabilities qualification. Stopped-controller gate is synthetic.
OCI/IMDS/Vault/ledger/material/binary/clock/floor admission dependencies are synthetic; real local marker/files do not qualify those services.
Explicit partial-stage setup exercises real source-defined reads/writes/renames; no power loss, process crash, reboot or image/host execution is established.
All safety/security/negative/retry/ordering/byte-preservation obligations remain retained. No deletion, retirement, ledger/count promotion, runtime qualification or global completion.
